Title: Excludes certain social workers employed or supervised by lawyers from reporting cases of suspected child abuse or maltreatment
Summary: Excludes certain social workers employed or supervised by lawyers from reporting cases of suspected child abuse or maltreatment when the belief of suspected child abuse or maltreatment arises solely out of the course of representation or the seeking of representation.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the social services law, in relation to excluding certain social workers employed or supervised by lawyers from reporting cases of suspected child abuse or maltreatment
